Name: New Crops Trio - Chives Peanuts and Golden Sweet Potatoes
Author: StarLight2024
Description:
[b]New Crops Trio[/b] adds three crops that don't exist in vanilla Stardew Valley, each with a full growth animation, seed packet, produce icon and a matching home-cooked dish.

[line]

[b][size=4]The crops[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Chives (韭菜)[/b] — spring. Matures in 6 days, then regrows every 3 days. Seed 60g, sells for 90g.[/*]
[*][b]Peanut (花生)[/b] — summer. Matures in 14 days and yields 1-3 peanuts per harvest. Seed 80g, sells for 130g.[/*]
[*][b]Golden Sweet Potato (地瓜)[/b] — fall. Matures in 14 days and yields 1-2 per harvest. Seed 100g, sells for 210g.[/*]
[/list]All three are sold by Pierre in their own season, and every crop has hand-made pixel art in vanilla style: 16x32 growth frames, 16x16 item icons, and an extra mature frame (chive flowers, peanut pods, exposed sweet potato) that appears once the crop is ready.

[line]

[b][size=4]The dishes[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Chive Pocket[/b] — chive x1 + wheat flour x1 + oil x1. Sells for 300g.[/*]
[*][b]Salted Peanut[/b] — peanut x2 + oil x1. Sells for 320g.[/*]
[*][b]Baked Golden Sweet Potato[/b] — golden sweet potato x1. Sells for 360g.[/*]
[/list]They are cooked in the normal kitchen menu — no custom machines, no new ingredients beyond what you grow.

[line]

[b][size=4]Pierre's seed gifts[/size][/b]

On the first day of spring, summer and fall, Pierre leaves an envelope in your mailbox with 5 free seeds (or slips) of that season's crop. It repeats every year, so you can always try the new crop without buying seeds first.

[b][size=4]Recipe unlocks[/size][/b]

The three recipes are learned from letters, not from the cooking skill:

[list]
[*][b]2 hearts with Pierre[/b] — Chive Pocket[/*]
[*][b]4 hearts with Pierre[/b] — Salted Peanut[/*]
[*][b]5 hearts with Pierre[/b] — Baked Golden Sweet Potato[/*]
[/list]When you reach a heart level, Pierre sends the recipe the next morning. Open the letter to learn it. Each unlock happens once per save; if your friendship is already high enough, the letters arrive after your next night's sleep.

[line]

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Content Patcher 2.0+[/*]
[/list]This is a pure Content Patcher content pack: it adds no code and does not replace any vanilla asset.

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Unzip the archive into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder so that
[code]QingQingCao.NewCropsPack[/code]sits next to Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]

The crops use their own item IDs and do not overwrite vanilla items, so they can be added to an existing save. 

[b][size=4]Credits[/size][/b]

Art, data and writing by QingQingCao. Sprites are original pixel art generated with a custom Python script and hand-tuned frame by frame. Built with Content Patcher by Pathoschild.

[line]

[b][size=4]中文说明[/size][/b]

本模组添加三种原版没有的作物，并为每种作物配上一道家常料理：

[list]
[*][b]韭菜[/b]：春季，6 天成熟，之后每 3 天可再收。种子 60 金，售价 90 金。[/*]
[*][b]花生[/b]：夏季，14 天成熟，一次收 1-3 颗。种子 80 金，售价 130 金。[/*]
[*][b]地瓜[/b]：秋季，14 天成熟，一次收 1-2 个。种子 100 金，售价 210 金。[/*]
[/list]每个季节的第一天，皮埃尔会往邮箱里寄 5 份当季种子，每年都会寄。三种作物都在皮埃尔商店按季出售。

料理在游戏原生烹饪界面制作：

[list]
[*]韭菜盒子：韭菜 x1 + 面粉 x1 + 油 x1，售价 300 金[/*]
[*]盐焗花生：花生 x2 + 油 x1，售价 320 金[/*]
[*]烤地瓜：地瓜 x1，售价 360 金[/*]
[/list]配方通过信件解锁：皮埃尔 2 心寄韭菜盒子，4 心寄盐焗花生，5 心寄烤地瓜；达到好感后的第二天早上收信，打开信件即可学会。

需要 Stardew Valley 1.6、SMAPI 4.0 和 Content Patcher 2.0。纯内容包，不含代码。

[line]

[b]Changelog 1.0.0[/b]
